g.text: Support choices matter for the Swedish curves
Recent eight windows · five latitude bands · area weights within each selected cohort
Unavailable policies remain gaps; no substitution, smoothing or fallback. Quality selection changes support as well as source quality.
Published REVEALS / PANGAEA 937075 · Swedish-centre grids · 31-taxon cover (%)
Source windows, BP relative to 1950; youngest interval follows source coring support. No interpolation or regional confidence intervals.
